text: I think you'll really enjoy this Tibetan Greens With Tofu recipe, which not only meets your vegan dietary requirement but also aligns with your goal of higher protein intake. The dish is packed with 31 grams of protein per serving, thanks to the firm tofu, which is a great source of plant-based protein. Additionally, the recipe is quick and easy to prepare, taking only about 20 minutes to get ready, which fits within your time budget of 45 minutes or less.
